$comment: Certifications are only nice-to-have here (CPP or FPC), so required_certifications is empty even though two taxonomy certifications are named; both go in preferred_certifications, where 'or' needs no special handling because a preference never filters. ADP and Excel are required; Workday and UKG appear only in a nice-to-have (UKG is not a taxonomy product, so it is in other_preferred_software), and the ADP named next to them is already required, so it is not preferred as well. Remote with Eastern hours gives the time zone; a written start date gives starts_on. Assisted living is healthcare.

requirements.title: Senior Payroll Specialist
must_haves: At least 3 years of end-to-end payroll processing on ADP Workforce Now
Multi-state payroll tax experience (we are in CA, WA, OR, AZ, CO, TX, FL, GA and NC)
Experience with a workforce of 1,000 or more hourly employees
Strong Excel skills for reconciliations and audits
Availability during Eastern Time business hours (8am to 5pm ET), from anywhere in the US
nice_to_haves: Healthcare, senior living or hospitality payroll background
Experience with an ADP to Workday or UKG migration
